documents.title: 3-Wire Expander
documents.intro: The triport class is used to configure a 3-Wire Expander, allowing additional 3-Wire ports to be used with the V5 Brain.
documents.zhIntro: triport 类用于配置 3 线扩展器，允许额外的三线端口与 V5 主控器一起使用。

documents.title: Accelerometer
documents.intro: The accelerometer class measures the acceleration of the robot along one or more axes. The sensor outputs an analog voltage that changes based on acceleration in G-forces (G).
documents.zhIntro: accelerometer 类测量机器人沿一个或多个轴的加速度。传感器输出一个模拟电压，该电压根据重力 (G) 的加速度而变化。

documents.title: Analog In
documents.intro: The analog_in class is used to read analog input signals from devices connected to a VEX V5 3-Wire port. It provides access to the current analog value and allows callback functions to be registered for value changes.
documents.zhIntro: analog_in 类用于从连接到 VEX V5 三线端口的设备读取模拟输入信号。它提供对当前模拟值的访问，并允许为值更改注册回调函数。

documents.title: Bumper Switch
documents.intro: The bumper class is used with the Bumper Switch, a mechanical switch that completes a circuit when pressed, allowing the robot to detect presses and releases.
documents.zhIntro: bumper 类与缓冲开关配合使用，缓冲开关是一种机械开关，按下时可形成电路，使机器人能够检测按下和释放。

documents.title: Digital In
documents.intro: The digital_in class allows the V5 Brain to read a digital signal from an external source, such as a switch or sensor. It detects whether the input line is high, receiving 5 volts, or low, receiving 0 volts. This can be used to determine on/off states or trigger events in a project.
documents.zhIntro: digital_in 类允许 V5 主控器从外部源读取数字信号，例如开关或传感器。它检测输入线是否为高电平（接收 5 伏）或低电平（接收 0 伏）。这可用于确定项目中的开/关状态或触发事件。

documents.title: Digital Out
documents.intro: The digital_out class allows the V5 Brain to send a digital signal to an external component such as an LED, relay, or other electronic device. It can send a high signal (5 volts) or a low signal (0 volts).
documents.zhIntro: digital_out 类允许 V5 主控器向外部组件发送数字信号，例如 LED、继电器或其他电子设备。它可以发送高信号（5 伏）或低信号（0 伏）。

documents.title: Encoder
documents.intro: The encoder class is used with the Optical Shaft Encoder, which measures the rotational position and speed of a shaft. It uses internal optical sensors to detect how far and how fast the shaft turns, making it useful for tracking wheel rotation, arm position, or other mechanisms.
documents.zhIntro: encoder 类与光轴编码器一起使用，可测量轴的旋转位置和速度。它使用内部光学传感器来检测轴转动的距离和速度，使其可用于跟踪车轮旋转、手臂位置或其他机制。
documents.text:
Encoder Introduction The encoder class is used with the Optical Shaft Encoder, which measures the rotational position and speed of a shaft. It uses internal optical sensors to detect how far and how fast the shaft turns, making it useful for tracking wheel rotation, arm position, or other mechanisms. Class Constructor encoder(
  triport::port &port ); Class Destructor Destroys the encoder object and releases associated resources. virtual ~encoder(); Parameters Parameter Type Description port triport::port & The first 3-Wire Port of a required two-port group used by the Optical Shaft Encoder. The encoder occupies two adjacent ports (A–B, C–D, E–F, or G–H) on either the Brain or a 3-Wire Expander. Specify the first port in the pair (A, C, E, or G), written as Brain.ThreeWirePort.X or ExpanderName.X where X is the port letter (for example, Brain.ThreeWirePort.A or Expander1.C ). Examples // Create an encoder instance in Ports A and B
encoder EncoderA = encoder(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); Member Functions The encoder class includes the following member functions: setPosition — Sets the encoder's current position to a specified value. position — Returns how far the encoder has rotated. velocity — Returns the current rotational velocity of the encoder. Before calling any encoder member functions, a encoder instance must be created, as shown below: /* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
Encoder configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create an encoder instance in Ports A and B
encoder EncoderA = encoder(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); setPosition Sets the encoder's current position to a specified value. This can be used to manually set the tracked position without rotating a motor or other mechanism. Available Functions void setPosition(
  double        value,
  rotationUnits units); Parameters Parameters Type Description value double The rotational position to set. units rotationUnits The unit that represents the position: deg / degrees — degrees turns / rev — revolutions Return Values This function does not return a value. position Returns how far the shaft connected to the encoder has rotated. Available Functions double position(
  rotationUnits units ); Parameters Parameters Type Description units rotationUnits The unit that represents the position: deg / degrees — degrees turns / rev — revolutions Return Values Returns a double representing the rotation in the specified units. velocity Returns the rotational velocity of the encoder. Available Functions double velocity(
  velocityUnits units ); Parameters Parameters Type Description units velocityUnits The unit used to represent the velocity: percent / pct — percent rpm — rotations per minute dps — degrees per second Return Values Returns a double representing the velocity in the specified units.
documents.zhText:
编码器 概述 encoder 类与光轴编码器一起使用，可测量轴的旋转位置和速度。它使用内部光学传感器来检测轴转动的距离和速度，使其可用于跟踪车轮旋转、手臂位置或其他机制。 构造函数 encoder(
  triport::port &port ); 析构函数 销毁 encoder 对象并释放关联资源。 virtual ~encoder(); 参数 参数 类型 说明 port triport::port & 光轴编码器使用的所需二端口组的第一个三线端口。编码器占用主控器或 3 线扩展器上的两个相邻端口（A–B、C–D、E–F 或 G–H）。指定端口对（A、C、E 或 G）中的第一个端口，写作 Brain.ThreeWirePort.X 或 ExpanderName.X ，其中 X 是端口号（例如， Brain.ThreeWirePort.A 或 Expander1.C ）。 示例 // Create an encoder instance in Ports A and B
encoder EncoderA = encoder(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); 成员函数 encoder 类包含以下成员函数： setPosition — 将编码器的当前位置设置为指定值。 position — 返回编码器旋转的距离。 velocity — 返回编码器的当前旋转速度。 在调用任何 encoder 成员函数之前，必须创建一个 encoder 实例，如下所示： /* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
Encoder configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create an encoder instance in Ports A and B
encoder EncoderA = encoder(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); setPosition 将编码器的当前位置设置为指定值。这可用于手动设置跟踪位置，而无需旋转电机或其他机构。 函数重载 void setPosition(
  double        value,
  rotationUnits units); 参数 参数 类型 说明 value double 要设置的旋转位置。 units rotationUnits 表示位置的单位： deg / degrees — 度 turns / rev — 转数 返回值 此函数无返回值。 position 返回连接到编码器的轴旋转了多远。 函数重载 double position(
  rotationUnits units ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units rotationUnits 表示位置的单位： deg / degrees — 度 turns / rev — 转数 返回值 返回表示指定单位旋转的 double 。 velocity 返回编码器的旋转速度。 函数重载 double velocity(
  velocityUnits units ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units velocityUnits 用于表示速度的单位： percent / pct — 百分比 rpm — 每分钟转数 dps — 每秒度数 返回值 返回一个 double ，表示指定单位的速度。

documents.title: Gyro Sensor
documents.intro: The gyro class is used to measure the robot’s heading and rotational movement, allowing tracking of orientation over time.
documents.zhIntro: gyro 类用于测量机器人的航向角和旋转运动，从而可以随时间跟踪方向。
documents.text:
Gyro Sensor Introduction The gyro class is used to measure the robot’s heading and rotational movement, allowing tracking of orientation over time. Class Constructor gyro(
  triport::port &port); Class Destructor Destroys the gyro object and releases associated resources. virtual ~gyro(); Parameters Parameter Type Description port triport::port & The 3-Wire Port that the Gyro Sensor is connected to, written as Brain.ThreeWirePort.X or ExpanderName.X , where X is the port letter (for example, Brain.ThreeWirePort.A or Expander1.A ). Example // Create a gyro instance in Port A
gyro GyroA = gyro(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); Member Functions The gyro class includes the following member functions: calibrate — Calibrates the gyro for stable heading tracking. setHeading — Sets the heading of the gyro. setRotation — Sets the current rotation value of the gyro. heading — Returns the heading of the gyro. rotation — Returns the rotation of the gyro. Before calling any gyro member functions, a gyro instance must be created, as shown below: /* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
Gyro Sensor configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create a gyro instance in Port A
gyro GyroA = gyro(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); calibrate Calibrates the Gyro Sensor. Available Functions void calibrate(
  int32_t value = 0 ); Parameters Parameters Type Description value int32_t The time in seconds to spend calibrating. Default is 0 . Return Values This function does not return a value. Notes calibrate should only be called when the sensor is not moving. Examples // Start calibration with the calibration time set to 3 seconds.
GyroA.calibrate(3); setHeading Sets the heading of the Gyro Sensor to a specific value. Available Functions void setHeading(
  double        value,
  rotationUnits units ); Parameters Type Description value double The value to use for the new heading. units rotationUnits The unit that represents the heading: degrees turns Return Values This function does not return a value. setRotation Sets the rotation of the Gyro Sensor to a specific value. Available Functions void setRotation(
  double        value,
  rotationUnits units ); Parameters Parameters Type Description value double The value to use for the new rotation value. units rotationUnits The unit that represents the rotation value: degrees turns Return Values This function does not return a value. heading Returns the current heading of the Gyro Sensor. Available Functions double heading(
  rotationUnits units = degrees ); Parameters Parameter Type Description units rotationUnits The unit that represents the heading: degrees (default) turns Return Values Returns a double representing the current heading of the Gyro Sensor in the specified units, defaulting to degrees . Examples // Get the current heading for the Gyro.
double value = GyroA.heading();
Brain.Screen.print(value); rotation Returns the current rotation of the Gyro Sensor. Available Functions double rotation(
  rotationUnits units = degrees ); Parameters Parameter Type Description units rotationUnits The unit that represents the rotation value: degrees (default) turns Return Values Returns a double representing the current rotation value of the Gyro Sensor in the specified units, defaulting to degrees . Examples // Get the current rotation for the Gyro.
double value = GyroA.rotation();
Brain.Screen.print(value);
documents.zhText:
陀螺仪 概述 gyro 类用于测量机器人的航向角和旋转运动，从而可以随时间跟踪方向。 构造函数 gyro(
  triport::port &port); 析构函数 销毁 gyro 对象并释放关联资源。 virtual ~gyro(); 参数 参数 类型 说明 port triport::port & 陀螺仪连接的三线端口，写为 Brain.ThreeWirePort.X 或 ExpanderName.X ，其中 X 为端口号（例如 Brain.ThreeWirePort.A 或 Expander1.A ）。 示例 // Create a gyro instance in Port A
gyro GyroA = gyro(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); 成员函数 gyro 类包含以下成员函数： calibrate — 校准陀螺仪以实现稳定的航向角跟踪。 setHeading — 设置陀螺仪的航向角。 setRotation — 设置陀螺仪的当前旋转值。 heading — 返回陀螺仪的航向角。 rotation — 返回陀螺仪的旋转。 在调用任何 gyro 成员函数之前，必须创建一个 gyro 实例，如下所示： /* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
Gyro Sensor configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create a gyro instance in Port A
gyro GyroA = gyro(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); calibrate 校准陀螺仪。 函数重载 void calibrate(
  int32_t value = 0 ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 value int32_t 校准所用的时间（以秒为单位）。默认为 0 。 返回值 此函数无返回值。 说明与注意事项 calibrate 仅应在传感器未移动时调用。 示例 // Start calibration with the calibration time set to 3 seconds.
GyroA.calibrate(3); setHeading 将陀螺仪的航向角设置为特定值。 函数重载 void setHeading(
  double        value,
  rotationUnits units ); 参数 类型 说明 value double 用于新航向角的值。 units rotationUnits 表示航向角的单位： degrees turns 返回值 此函数无返回值。 setRotation 将陀螺仪的旋转设置为特定值。 函数重载 void setRotation(
  double        value,
  rotationUnits units ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 value double 用于新旋转值的值。 units rotationUnits 表示旋转值的单位： degrees turns 返回值 此函数无返回值。 heading 返回陀螺仪当前的航向角。 函数重载 double heading(
  rotationUnits units = degrees ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units rotationUnits 表示航向角的单位： degrees （默认） turns 返回值 返回一个 double ，以指定单位表示陀螺仪当前的航向角，默认为 degrees 。 示例 // Get the current heading for the Gyro.
double value = GyroA.heading();
Brain.Screen.print(value); rotation 返回陀螺仪当前的旋转角度。 函数重载 double rotation(
  rotationUnits units = degrees ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units rotationUnits 表示旋转值的单位： degrees （默认） turns 返回值 返回一个 double ，以指定单位表示陀螺仪的当前旋转值，默认为 degrees 。 示例 // Get the current rotation for the Gyro.
double value = GyroA.rotation();
Brain.Screen.print(value);

documents.title: LED Indicator
documents.intro: The led class allows the V5 Brain to turn a connected light-emitting diode (LED) on or off using a 3-Wire Port.
documents.zhIntro: led 类允许 V5 主控器使用三线端口打开或关闭连接的发光二极管 (LED)。

documents.title: Light Sensor
documents.intro: The light class is used with the Light Sensor, which measures the brightness of light reflected from or shining on an object. It outputs an analog value that represents how much light is detected.
documents.zhIntro: light 类与光传感器一起使用，可测量从物体反射或照射在物体上的光的亮度。它输出一个模拟值，表示检测到的光量。

documents.title: Limit Switch
documents.intro: The limit class is used with the Limit Switch, a small digital sensor that detects physical contact with an object.
documents.zhIntro: limit 类与限位开关配合使用，限位开关是一种小型数字传感器，可检测与物体的物理接触。

documents.title: Line Tracker
documents.intro: The line class is used with the Line Tracker, an analog sensor that uses an infrared LED and light sensor to detect the reflectivity of the surface in front of it. It is designed to be mounted under the chassis of a robot so that the robot can follow a pre-marked path.
documents.zhIntro: line 类与线路跟踪器一起使用，线路跟踪器是一种模拟传感器，使用红外 LED 和光传感器来检测其前面的表面的反射率。它被设计安装在机器人底盘下方，以便机器人可以遵循预先标记的路径。
documents.text:
Line Tracker Introduction The line class is used with the Line Tracker, an analog sensor that uses an infrared LED and light sensor to detect the reflectivity of the surface in front of it. It is designed to be mounted under the chassis of a robot so that the robot can follow a pre-marked path. Class Constructor line(
  triport::port &port ); Class Destructor Destroys the line object and releases associated resources. virtual ~line(); Parameters Parameter Type Description port triport::port & The 3-Wire Port that the Line Tracker is connected to, written as Brain.ThreeWirePort.X or ExpanderName.X , where X is the port letter (for example, Brain.ThreeWirePort.A or Expander1.A ). Examples // Create a line instance in Port A
line LineTrackerA = line(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); Member Functions The line class includes the following member functions: reflectivity — Returns an int32_t that represents the amount of light reflected from the surface as a percent. Before calling any line member functions, a line instance must be created, as shown below: /* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
Line Tracker configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create a line instance in Port A
line LineTrackerA = line(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); reflectivity Returns an int32_t that represents the amount of light reflected from the surface as a percent. This can be used to help a robot follow a pre-marked path. Note: 0% reflectivity means the object is very dark. 100% reflectivity means the object is very bright. Available Functions int32_t reflectivity(
  percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct ); Parameters Parameter Type Description units percentUnits The unit that represents the reflectivity: percent / pct (default) — percent Return Values Returns an int32_t representing the reflectivity measured by the Line Tracker as a percent in the range 0 - 100%. Examples // Display the detected reflectivity
int32_t value = LineTrackerA.reflectivity();
Brain.Screen.print(value);
documents.zhText:
巡线传感器 概述 line 类与线路跟踪器一起使用，线路跟踪器是一种模拟传感器，使用红外 LED 和光传感器来检测其前面的表面的反射率。它被设计安装在机器人底盘下方，以便机器人可以遵循预先标记的路径。 构造函数 line(
  triport::port &port ); 析构函数 销毁 line 对象并释放关联资源。 virtual ~line(); 参数 参数 类型 说明 port triport::port & Line Tracker 连接的三线端口，写作 Brain.ThreeWirePort.X 或 ExpanderName.X ，其中 X 是端口号（例如 Brain.ThreeWirePort.A 或 Expander1.A ）。 示例 // Create a line instance in Port A
line LineTrackerA = line(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); 成员函数 line 类包含以下成员函数： reflectivity - 返回 int32_t ，以百分比形式表示从表面反射的光量。 在调用任何 line 成员函数之前，必须创建一个 line 实例，如下所示： /* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
Line Tracker configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create a line instance in Port A
line LineTrackerA = line(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); reflectivity 返回 int32_t ，表示从表面反射的光量（以百分比形式表示）。这可用于帮助机器人遵循预先标记的路径。 注： 0% 反射率表示物体非常暗。 100%反射率意味着物体非常明亮。 可用功能 int32_t reflectivity(
  percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units percentUnits 表示反射率的单位： percent / pct （默认）— 百分比 返回值 返回 int32_t ，表示线路跟踪器测量的反射率，以 0 - 100% 范围内的百分比表示。 示例 // Display the detected reflectivity
int32_t value = LineTrackerA.reflectivity();
Brain.Screen.print(value);

documents.title: PWM Out
documents.intro: The pwm_out class is used to control PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) output on a VEX V5 3-Wire port. It allows devices to send variable-width pulse signals to compatible 3-Wire components.
documents.zhIntro: pwm_out 类用于控制 VEX V5 三线端口上的 PWM（脉冲宽度调制）输出。它允许设备向兼容的 3 线组件发送可变宽度脉冲信号。

documents.title: Pneumatics
documents.intro: The VEX V5 Brain can control a V5 Pneumatics system using the pneumatics class. This class allows the Brain to open or close the system, extending or retracting pneumatic cylinders.
documents.zhIntro: VEX V5 主控制器可以使用 pneumatics 类控制 V5 气动系统 。该类允许主控制器打开或关闭系统，伸出或缩回气缸。
documents.text:
Pneumatics Introduction The VEX V5 Brain can control a V5 Pneumatics system using the pneumatics class. This class allows the Brain to open or close the system, extending or retracting pneumatic cylinders. The Pneumatics device must be manually constructed in code and cannot be added using the Device Menu in VEXcode V5. Class Constructors pneumatics( 
  triport::port &port ); Class Destructor Destroys the pneumatics object and releases associated resources. ~pneumatics(); Parameters Parameter Type Description &port triport::port The 3-Wire Port the Pneumatic Solenoid is connected to, written as Brain.ThreeWirePort.X or ExpanderName.X , where X is the port letter (for example, Brain.ThreeWirePort.A or Expander1.A ). Notes This class can only be constructed manually in code, as it cannot be constructed using the Device Menu in VEXcode V5. A Brain or 3-Wire Expander must be created first before they can be used to create an object with the pneumatics class constructor. Example // Create the pneumatics instance on 3-Wire Port A
pneumatics PneumaticsA = pneumatics(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); Member Functions The pneumatics class includes the following member functions: open — Sets the Pneumatic Solenoid to the open state, allowing air to flow into the cylinder. close — Sets the Pneumatic Solenoid to the close state, stopping air from flowing into the cylinder. Before calling any pneumatics member functions, a pneumatics instance must be created, as shown below: /* This constructor is required to use a
V5 Pneumatics Solenoid when not configured as
a Digital Out device. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create the pneumatics instance on 3-Wire Port A
pneumatics PneumaticsA = pneumatics(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); open Sets the Pneumatic Solenoid to the open state, allowing air to flow into the cylinder. Available Functions void open(); Parameters This function does not take any parameters. Return Values This function does not return a value. Examples // Open the solenoid to extend the cylinder
PneumaticsA.open(); close Sets the Pneumatic Solenoid to the close state, stopping air from flowing into the cylinder. Available Functions void close(); Parameters This function does not take any parameters. Return Values This function does not return a value. Examples // Close the solenoid to retract the cylinder
PneumaticsA.close();
documents.zhText:
气动装置 概述 VEX V5 主控制器可以使用 pneumatics 类控制 V5 气动系统 。该类允许主控制器打开或关闭系统，伸出或缩回气缸。 气动设备必须在代码中手动构建，并且无法使用 VEXcode V5 中的设备菜单添加。 构造函数 pneumatics( 
  triport::port &port ); 析构函数 销毁 pneumatics 对象并释放关联资源。 ~pneumatics(); 参数 参数 类型 说明 &port triport::port 气动电磁阀连接的三线端口，写作 Brain.ThreeWirePort.X 或 ExpanderName.X ，其中 X 是端口字母（例如 Brain.ThreeWirePort.A 或 Expander1.A ）。 说明与注意事项 该类只能在代码中手动构建，因为它无法使用 VEXcode V5 中的设备菜单构建。 必须首先创建主控器或 3 线扩展器，然后才能使用它们来创建具有 pneumatics 类构造函数的对象。 示例 // Create the pneumatics instance on 3-Wire Port A
pneumatics PneumaticsA = pneumatics(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); 成员函数 pneumatics 类包含以下成员函数： open — 将气动电磁阀设置为打开状态，允许空气流入气缸。 close — 将气动电磁阀设置为关闭状态，阻止空气流入气缸。 在调用任何 pneumatics 成员函数之前，必须创建一个 pneumatics 实例，如下所示： /* This constructor is required to use a
V5 Pneumatics Solenoid when not configured as
a Digital Out device. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create the pneumatics instance on 3-Wire Port A
pneumatics PneumaticsA = pneumatics(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A); open 将气动电磁阀设置为打开状态，使空气流入气缸。 函数重载 void open(); 参数 此函数不接受参数。 返回值 此函数无返回值。 示例 // Open the solenoid to extend the cylinder
PneumaticsA.open(); close 将气动电磁阀设置为关闭状态，阻止空气流入气缸。 函数重载 void close(); 参数 此函数不接受参数。 返回值 此函数无返回值。 示例 // Close the solenoid to retract the cylinder
PneumaticsA.close();

documents.title: Potentiometer
documents.intro: The pot and potV2 classes are used with Potentiometers, which are analog sensors that measure the angular position of a rotating shaft. A Potentiometer outputs a voltage proportional to its position.
documents.zhIntro: pot 和 potV2 类与电位计一起使用，电位计是测量旋转轴角位置的模拟传感器。电位计输出与其位置成比例的电压。

documents.title: Range Finder
documents.intro: The sonar class is used with the Ultrasonic Range Finder, which measures the distance to the nearest object using sound waves. It works by sending out an ultrasonic pulse and measuring how long it takes for the sound to bounce back.
documents.zhIntro: sonar 类与超声波测距仪配合使用，利用声波测量到最近物体的距离。它的工作原理是发出超声波脉冲并测量声音反弹所需的时间。

documents.title: 3-Wire Devices
documents.intro: 3-Wire devices connect to the three-pin ports on the V5 Brain. These devices include sensors, legacy motors, and actuators that communicate using simple analog or digital signals.
documents.zhIntro: 3线设备连接到V5主控器上的三针端口。这些设备包括使用简单模拟或数字信号进行通信的传感器、传统电机和执行器。
documents.text: 3-Wire Devices 3-Wire devices connect to the three-pin ports on the V5 Brain. These devices include sensors, legacy motors, and actuators that communicate using simple analog or digital signals. Below is a list of available 3-Wire devices: 3-Wire Expander - A 3-Wire Expander adds additional 3-Wire ports when all of a Brain's built-in ports are in use. Accelerometer - Detects acceleration and tilt along multiple axes to measure motion and orientation. The sensor includes a jumper that adjusts sensitivity between 2G and 6G ranges. Analog In - Reads a continuous voltage signal from an analog 3-Wire sensor to report values across a range. Bumper Switch -  A spring-loaded switch used for detecting collisions or impacts on the robot. Digital In - Reads binary input signals (high or low) from external devices such as switches or sensors. Digital Out - Sends binary output signals (high or low) to control external devices like LEDs or relays. Encoder - Measures the relative rotational position and direction of a shaft to determine speed or distance traveled. Gyro Sensor - The Gyro Sensor measures the heading and the rotation of the robot. LED Indicator - Controls LED Indicators by turning them on or off. Light Sensor - Measures the intensity of ambient light to detect brightness or contrast changes in the robot's environment. Limit Switch - A small switch that detects contact with objects or surfaces. Line Tracker - Detects differences in light reflection, allowing the robot to follow lines on the field surface. Motor 393 - A legacy DC motor from VEX EDR systems. Object Sensor - Uses infrared reflection to detect whether an object is nearby, returning a digital signal when something is within range. Used with the CTE Workcell. Potentiometer - Measures the angular position of a rotating shaft or mechanism. The sensor supports 270 degrees of rotation. V5 Pneumatics - Control the V5 Pneumatic Solenoid. Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) - Outputs a pulse-width-modulated control signal through a 3-Wire port to drive legacy motor controllers or servos. Range Finder - Uses ultrasonic sound waves to measure the distance between the sensor and nearby objects. Servo Motor - A position-controlled motor used to rotate mechanisms to specific angles. Victor Motor - A legacy motor controller that takes a 3-Wire PWM signal from the Brain to control VEXpro/EDR DC motors that can't plug directly into Smart Ports.
documents.zhText: 三线设备 3线设备连接到V5主控器上的三针端口。这些设备包括使用简单模拟或数字信号进行通信的传感器、传统电机和执行器。 以下是可用 3 线设备的列表： 3线扩展器 - 当主控器的所有内置端口都在使用时，3线扩展器添加额外的三线端口。 加速度计 - 检测沿多个轴的加速度和倾斜，以测量运动和方向。该传感器包括一个跳线，可在 2G 和 6G 范围之间调节灵敏度。 模拟输入 - 从模拟 3 线传感器读取连续电压信号以报告一定范围内的值。 缓冲开关 - 用于检测机器人碰撞或冲击的弹簧开关。 数字输入 - 从开关或传感器等外部设备读取二进制输入信号（高或低）。 数字输出 - 发送二进制输出信号（高或低）以控制 LED 或继电器等外部设备。 编码器 - 测量轴的相对旋转位置和方向以确定速度或行驶距离。 陀螺仪 - 陀螺仪测量机器人的航向角和旋转。 LED 指示灯 - 通过打开或关闭 LED 指示灯来控制它们。 光传感器 - 测量环境光强度以检测机器人环境中的亮度或对比度变化。 限位开关 - 检测与物体或表面接触的小型开关。 线路跟踪器 - 检测光反射的差异，使机器人能够跟踪场地表面上的线路。 电机 393 - VEX EDR 系统的传统直流电机。 物体传感器 - 使用红外反射来检测附近是否有物体，当物体在范围内时返回数字信号。与 CTE 工作单元一起使用。 电位计 - 测量旋转轴或机构的角位置。传感器支持270度旋转。 V5 气动装置 - 控制 V5 气动电磁阀。 脉宽调制 (PWM) - 通过三线端口输出脉宽调制控制信号，以驱动传统电机照明或伺服系统。 测距仪 - 使用超声波测量传感器与附近物体之间的距离。 伺服电机 - 用于将机构旋转到特定角度的位置控制电机。 维克多电机 - 传统电机照明，采用主控器的 3 线 PWM 信号来控制无法直接插入智能端口的 VEXpro/EDR 直流电机。

documents.title: Battery
documents.intro: The battery class is derived from the brain base class and provides access to the V5 Brain’s battery, allowing your robot to monitor capacity, voltage, current draw, power usage, temperature, and efficiency.
documents.zhIntro: battery 类派生自 brain 基类，并提供对 V5 主控器电池的访问，使您的机器人能够监控容量、电压、电流消耗、电量使用情况、温度和效率。
documents.text:
Battery Introduction The battery class is derived from the brain base class and provides access to the V5 Brain’s battery, allowing your robot to monitor capacity, voltage, current draw, power usage, temperature, and efficiency. Access Brain.Battery Member Functions The battery class includes the following member functions: voltage — Returns the battery voltage. current — Returns the battery current draw. capacity — Returns the brain's remaining battery capacity. temperature — Returns the battery temperature. Before calling any battery member functions, a brain instance must be created, as shown below: // Create the V5 Brain
brain Brain = brain(); voltage Returns the voltage of the V5 Brain battery. Voltage is the electrical pressure supplied to the battery, which can help you check whether the battery is charged enough for the robot to run reliably. Available Functions double voltage( voltageUnits units = voltageUnits::volt ); Parameters Parameter Type Description units voltageUnits Optional. The unit used to represent voltage: volt (default) — volts, or mV — millivolts Return Values Returns a double representing the battery voltage in the specified units. current Returns the electrical current drawn from the V5 Brain battery. Current is how much electrical flow the robot is using from the battery, which can help you see how hard the robot is working or whether motors may be under extra load, ranging from 0.0 to 20.0 Amps. Available Functions double current( currentUnits units = currentUnits::amp ); Parameters Parameter Type Description units currentUnits Optional. The unit used to represent current: amp (default) — amperes Return Values Returns a double representing the electrical current drawn from the V5 Brain battery in amperes. capacity Returns the remaining battery level of the V5 Brain battery. Available Functions uint32_t capacity( percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct ); Parameters Parameter Type Description units percentUnits Optional. The unit used to represent battery capacity: pct / percent — percent Return Values Returns a uint32_t representing the remaining battery capacity as a percentage from 0% to 100%. temperature Returns the temperature of the V5 Brain battery. Available Functions 1 — Returns the battery temperature as a percentage. double temperature(
    percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct ); 2 — Returns the battery temperature in the specified temperature units. double temperature(
    temperatureUnits units ); Parameters Parameter Type Description units percentUnits Optional. The unit used to represent battery temperature: pct / percent (default) — percent units temperatureUnits Returns the battery temperature in specific units: celsius — degrees Celsius, or fahrenheit — degrees Fahrenheit Return Values Returns a double representing the remaining battery temperature in the specified units. Notes The operating temperature range for the battery is approximately 20°C ( 68°F ) to 70°C ( 158°F ).
documents.zhText:
电池 概述 battery 类派生自 brain 基类，并提供对 V5 主控器电池的访问，使您的机器人能够监控容量、电压、电流消耗、电量使用情况、温度和效率。 访问 Brain.Battery 成员函数 battery 类包含以下成员函数： voltage — 返回电池电压。 current — 返回电池电流消耗。 capacity — 返回主控制器的剩余电池电量。 temperature — 返回电池温度。 在调用任何 battery 成员函数之前，必须创建一个 brain 实例，如下所示： // Create the V5 Brain
brain Brain = brain(); voltage 返回V5主控器电池电压。电压是提供给电池的电压，可以帮助您检查电池电量是否足够机器人可靠运行。 函数重载 double voltage( voltageUnits units = voltageUnits::volt ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units voltageUnits 选修的。用于表示电压的单位： volt （默认）— 伏特，或 mV — 毫伏 返回值 返回 double ，以指定单位表示电池电压。 current 返回从 V5 主控制器电池汲取的电流。电流是机器人使用电池的电流量，它可以帮助您了解机器人的工作强度或电机是否可能承受额外负载，范围从 0.0 到 20.0 安培。 函数重载 double current( currentUnits units = currentUnits::amp ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units currentUnits 可选。用于表示电流的单位： amp （默认）—安培 返回值 返回 double ，表示从 V5 主控器电池汲取的电流（以安培为单位）。 capacity 返回V5主控器电池的剩余电量。 函数重载 uint32_t capacity( percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units percentUnits 可选。用于表示电池容量的单位： pct / percent — 百分比 返回值 返回 uint32_t ，以 0% 到 100% 的百分比表示剩余电池容量。 temperature 返回V5主控器电池的温度。 函数重载 1 — 以百分比形式返回电池温度。 double temperature(
    percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct ); 2 — 以指定温度单位返回电池温度。 double temperature(
    temperatureUnits units ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units percentUnits 可选。用于表示电池温度的单位： pct / percent （默认）—百分比 units temperatureUnits 返回特定单位的电池温度： celsius — 摄氏度，或 fahrenheit — 华氏度 返回值 返回 double ，以指定单位表示剩余电池温度。 说明与注意事项 电池的工作温度范围约为 20°C ( 68°F ) 至 70°C ( 158°F )。

documents.title: SDcard
documents.intro: The sdcard class is derived from the brain base class and provides access to files stored on a removable SD card inserted into the V5 Brain.
documents.zhIntro: sdcard 类派生自 brain 基类，并提供对插入 V5 主控器的可移动 SD 卡上存储的文件的访问。

documents.title: Screen
documents.intro: The screen class is derived from the brain base class. It controls how the V5 Brain shows text, numbers, and graphics on its touchscreen, and how it responds to touch input.
documents.zhIntro: screen 类派生自 brain 基类。它控制V5主控制器如何在触摸屏上显示文本、数字和图形，以及如何响应触摸输入。

documents.title: Brain
documents.intro: In VEX V5 C++, the Brain is represented by the brain class. You create (or use the default project-provided) Brain object and then access Brain features through its member objects.
documents.zhIntro: 在VEX V5 C++中，主控器由 brain 类表示。您创建（或使用项目提供的默认）主控器对象，然后通过其成员对象访问主控器功能。

documents.title: Timer
documents.intro: The timer class is derived from the brain base class and provides functionality for measuring elapsed time, allowing you to track durations and schedule time-based events within a VEX V5 program.
documents.zhIntro: timer 类派生自 brain 基类，并提供测量经过时间的功能，允许您在 VEX V5 程序中跟踪持续时间并安排基于时间的事件。

documents.title: CTE Arm
documents.intro: The arm class provides control for the 6-Axis Arm used in the CTE Workcell. In VEX V5 C++, the 6-Axis Arm can move an end effector to positions in three-dimensional space, rotate the end effector, check whether movements are possible, and control attached tools such as the Magnet Pickup Tool or Pen Holder Tool.
documents.zhIntro: arm 类为 CTE 工作单元中使用的 6 轴臂提供控制。在VEX V5 C++中，6轴臂可以将末端执行器移动到三维空间中的位置，旋转末端执行器，检查是否可以移动，并控制附加工具，例如磁铁拾取工具或笔架工具。

documents.title: Object Sensor
documents.intro: The objectdetector class is used to measure reflectivity and detect objects by the Object Sensor.
documents.zhIntro: objectdetector 类用于测量反射率并通过物体传感器检测物体。

documents.title: Pneumatics
documents.intro: The VEX V5 Brain can control the CTE Pneumatic system using the pneumatic class. This class allows the Brain to control the pneumatic pump and extend or retract pneumatic cylinders.
documents.zhIntro: VEX V5主控器可以使用 pneumatic 类控制 CTE气动系统 。该类允许主控制器控制气动泵以及伸出或缩回气缸。

documents.title: Signal Tower
documents.intro: The signaltower class is used to change lights and detect interactions with the CTE Signal Tower.
documents.zhIntro: signaltower 类用于改变灯光并检测与 CTE 信号塔的交互。

documents.title: CTE Workcell
documents.intro: The VEX CTE Workcell includes specialized devices used to simulate automated material handling and industrial control systems. These devices provide precise motion control and sensing within the VEX CTE Workcell environment.
documents.zhIntro: VEX CTE Workcell 包括用于模拟自动化物料搬运和工业控制系统的专用设备。这些设备在 VEX CTE Workcell 环境中提供精确的运动控制和传感。
documents.text: CTE Workcell The VEX CTE Workcell includes specialized devices used to simulate automated material handling and industrial control systems. These devices provide precise motion control and sensing within the VEX CTE Workcell environment. Below is a list of available CTE Workcell devices: Arm - A 6-Axis robotic arm that provides precise positioning and movement control for pick-and-place operations and complex manipulations. Object Sensor - Detects the presence and properties of objects within the workcell environment for automated sorting and handling. Pneumatics - Controls pneumatic solenoids for air-powered actuators and mechanisms in the workcell. Signal Tower - A visual indicator system with multiple colored LEDs and button input for status monitoring and user interaction.
documents.zhText: CTE 工作站 VEX CTE Workcell 包括用于模拟自动化物料搬运和工业控制系统的专用设备。这些设备在 VEX CTE Workcell 环境中提供精确的运动控制和传感。 以下是可用 CTE Workcell 设备的列表： 手臂 - 一款 6 轴机械臂，可为拾放操作和复杂操作提供精确定位和运动控制。 物体传感器 - 检测工作单元环境中物体的存在和属性，以进行自动分类和处理。 气动装置 - 控制工作单元中气动执行器和机构的气动电磁阀。 信号塔 - 视觉指示器系统，具有多种彩色 LED 和按钮输入，用于状态监控和用户交互。

documents.title: Competition
documents.intro: The competition class helps you structure a V5 project for official competition control. It lets you register functions to run during Autonomous and Driver Control, and provides simple status checks so your code can respond to match state (enabled/disabled, autonomous/driver, field control, etc.).
documents.zhIntro: competition 类用于组织接受官方竞赛系统控制的 V5 程序。它支持注册自动阶段和手动控制阶段的执行函数，并提供启用、禁用、自动模式、手动控制模式及场地控制连接状态等查询，让程序根据比赛状态作出响应。

documents.title: Console
documents.intro: The VEXcode V5 Console is displayed in the Monitor window within VEXcode. Console output can display text, numbers, and variable values while a project is running.
documents.zhIntro: VEXcode V5 控制台显示在 VEXcode 内的“监视器”窗口中。项目运行时，控制台输出可以显示文本、数字和变量值。

documents.title: Axis
documents.intro: The axis class is a derived class of the controller class. It provides access to Controller joystick axis values and joystick axis change callbacks.
documents.zhIntro: axis 类是 controller 类的派生类。它提供对 遥感操纵杆轴值和操纵杆轴变化回调的访问。

documents.title: Button
documents.intro: The button class is a derived class of the controller class. It provides access to Controller button states and button event callbacks.
documents.zhIntro: button 类是 controller 类的派生类。它提供对 QI 按钮状态和按钮事件回调的访问。

documents.title: Screen
documents.intro: The screen class is a derived class of the controller class. It provides functions for displaying text, numbers, and values on the V5 Controller screen.
documents.zhIntro: screen 类是 controller 类的派生类。提供在V5背光屏上显示文字、数字、数值的功能。

documents.title: Controller
documents.intro: The controller class represents a VEX V5 Controller connected to the V5 Brain. A controller object can be used to access joystick axis values, read button states, register button or joystick callbacks, make the Controller rumble, write to the Controller screen, and check whether the Controller is connected.
documents.zhIntro: controller 类代表连接到 V5 主控器的 VEX V5 照明。 controller 对象可用于访问操纵杆轴值、读取按钮状态、注册按钮或操纵杆回调、使 Optimum 发出隆隆声、写入 Optimum 屏幕以及检查 Optimum 是否已连接。

documents.title: Drivetrain
documents.intro: The drivetrain class controls how a robot drives and turns. A drivetrain is made of motors and wheels that work together to move the robot.
documents.zhIntro: drivetrain 类用于控制机器人的行驶与转向。传动系统由电机和车轮组成，各部件协同工作以驱动机器人运动。
documents.text:
Drivetrain Introduction The drivetrain class controls how a robot drives and turns. A drivetrain is made of motors and wheels that work together to move the robot. A drivetrain does not use an Inertial Sensor , Gyro Sensor , or GPS Sensor for heading-based or rotation-based turns. It can drive forward or reverse and turn left or right, but it cannot turn to a specific heading or rotation. For heading-based and rotation-based turns, use the smartdrive class. Derived Classes The drivetrain class serves as a base class for the following derived classes: smartdrive - This class adds Inertial Sensor, GPS Sensor, or Gyro Sensor support to enable heading-based and rotation-based turns. Class Constructors 1 - Creates a drivetrain using existing motor_group objects for the left ( &l ) and right ( &r ) sides. drivetrain(
    motor_group      &l,
    motor_group      &r,
    double           wheelTravel = 320,
    double           trackWidth = 320,
    double           wheelBase = 130,
    distanceUnits    unit = mm,
    double           externalGearRatio = 1.0 ); 2 - Creates a drivetrain using existing motor objects for the left ( &l ) and right ( &r ) sides. drivetrain(
    motor            &l,
    motor            &r,
    double           wheelTravel = 320,
    double           trackWidth = 320,
    double           wheelBase = 130,
    distanceUnits    unit = mm,
    double           externalGearRatio = 1.0 ); Class Destructor Destroys the drivetrain object and releases associated resources. virtual ~drivetrain(); Parameters Parameter Type Description &l / &r motor_group / motor The left and right motors or motor groups. Both parameters must use the same type: either two motor_group objects or two motor objects. wheelTravel double The circumference of the drivetrain wheels. The default is 320 . trackWidth double The distance between the left and right wheels. The default is 320 . wheelBase double The distance between the front and back wheels. The default is 130 . unit distanceUnits The unit for wheelTravel , trackWidth , and wheelBase : mm (millimeters, default) or inches . externalGearRatio double The gear ratio used to adjust drive distances if gears are used. The default is 1.0 . Example // Create the left and right motor objects
motor leftMotor = motor(PORT1, false);
motor rightMotor = motor(PORT9, true);

// Create the drivetrain object
drivetrain myDrivetrain = drivetrain(
    leftMotor,  // left motor object
    rightMotor, // right motor object
    259.34,     // wheelTravel
    320,        // trackWidth
    40,         // wheelBase
    mm,         // unit
    1.0 );      // externalGearRatio Member Functions The drivetrain class includes the following member functions: Actions - Move and turn the robot. drive - Moves the robot forward or reverse forever. driveFor - Moves the robot forward or reverse for a specific distance. turn - Turns the robot left or right forever. turnFor - Turns the robot left or right for a specific number of degrees. stop - Stops the robot's movement. Settings - Adjust drivetrain settings. setDriveVelocity - Tells the robot how fast to drive. setTurnVelocity - Tells the robot how fast to turn. setStopping - Tells how the robot will stop moving: by braking, coasting, or holding. setTimeout - Sets how many seconds the robot will try to finish a movement. Values - Check movement status. isDone - Returns whether the robot is finished moving, as a Boolean value. isMoving - Returns whether the robot is moving, as a Boolean value. velocity - Returns how fast the robot is driving. current - Returns how much electrical current the drivetrain is using. power - Returns how quickly the drivetrain is using energy. torque - Returns how much torque the drivetrain is using. efficiency - Returns how efficiently the drivetrain is using power. temperature - Returns how warm the drivetrain is. voltage - Returns the electrical voltage supplied to the drivetrain. Before calling any drivetrain member functions, a drivetrain object must be created, as shown below: /* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
Drivetrain configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create the left and right motor objects
motor leftMotor = motor(PORT1, false);
motor rightMotor = motor(PORT9, true);

// Create the drivetrain object
drivetrain myDrivetrain = drivetrain(
    leftMotor,  // left motor object
    rightMotor, // right motor object
    259.34,     // wheelTravel
    320,        // trackWidth
    40,         // wheelBase
    mm,         // unit
    1.0 );      // externalGearRatio Actions drive drive moves the robot forward or reverse forever. The robot will continue to move until it is given another action, like turning or stopping. For RPM or DPS, the limit is changed by the gear ratio of the drivetrain. Available Functions 1 - Drives using the currently configured drive velocity . void drive(
    directionType dir ); 2 - Drives at the specified velocity. void drive(
    directionType dir,
    double        velocity,
    velocityUnits units ); Parameters Parameter Type Description dir directionType The direction the robot moves: forward or reverse . velocity double The velocity to drive with from 0% to 100% when using velocityUnits::pct , from 0 to 600 rpm when using rpm , or from 0 to 3600 degrees per second when using dps . If no velocity is provided, the robot drives at the current drive velocity. units velocityUnits The velocity unit: velocityUnits::pct (percent), rpm (rotations per minute), or dps (degrees per second). Return Values This function does not return a value. Notes drive is non-waiting; the project will continue executing the next line of code immediately after the call. The drivetrain will continue moving until stop is called or another drivetrain movement function (such as driveFor or turn ) is executed. Functions such as isDone and isMoving are not applicable to drive , since it does not use target-based movement (doesn't have a distance parameter). Examples // Drive forward and back
myDrivetrain.drive(forward);
wait(2, seconds);
myDrivetrain.drive(reverse, 25, rpm);
wait(2, seconds);
myDrivetrain.stop(); driveFor driveFor moves the robot forward or reverse for a specific distance. The project will wait until the robot is done moving before the next line of code runs by default. For RPM or DPS, the limit is changed by the gear ratio of the drivetrain. Available Functions 1 - Drives in the specified direction for a distance using the currently configured drive velocity . bool driveFor(
    directionType dir,
    double        distance,
    distanceUnits units,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); 2 - Drives in a direction dependent on the distance using the currently configured drive velocity . bool driveFor(
    double        distance,
    distanceUnits units,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); 3 - Drives in a direction dependent on the distance at the specified velocity. bool driveFor(
    double        distance,
    distanceUnits units,
    double        velocity,
    velocityUnits units_v,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); 4 - Drives in the specified direction for a distance at the specified velocity. bool driveFor(
    directionType dir,
    double        distance,
    distanceUnits units,
    double        velocity,
    velocityUnits units_v,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); Parameters Parameter Type Description dir directionType The direction the robot moves: forward or reverse . distance double The distance the robot drives. units distanceUnits The distance unit: mm (millimeters), inches , or cm (centimeters). velocity double The velocity to drive with from 0% to 100% when using velocityUnits::pct , from 0 to 600 rpm when using rpm , or from 0 to 3600 degrees per second when using dps . If no velocity is provided, the robot drives at the current drive velocity. units_v velocityUnits The velocity unit: velocityUnits::pct (percent), rpm (rotations per minute), or dps (degrees per second). waitForCompletion bool true (default) makes the project wait until the robot is done moving before the next line of code runs. false makes the next line of code run right away. Return Values Returns whether the robot reached the target distance, as a Boolean value. true - The robot reached the target distance. false - The robot did not finish the movement, or the function returned before the movement completed because waitForCompletion was set to false . Notes Executing another drivetrain movement function (such as drive or turnFor ) while driveFor is in progress will interrupt the current movement. Because driveFor is target-based (uses a distance parameter), functions such as isDone and isMoving work with driveFor . Examples // Drive 200 mm, then back 200 mm
myDrivetrain.driveFor(forward, 200, mm);
myDrivetrain.driveFor(reverse, 200, mm); turn turn turns the robot left or right forever. The robot will continue to turn until it is given another action, like driving or stopping. For RPM or DPS, the limit is changed by the gear ratio of the drivetrain. Available Functions 1 - Turns using the currently configured turn velocity . void turn(
    turnType dir ); 2 - Turns at the specified velocity. void turn(
    turnType     dir,
    double       velocity,
    velocityUnits units ); Parameters Parameter Type Description dir turnType The direction the robot turns: left or right . velocity double The velocity to turn with from 0% to 100% when using velocityUnits::pct , from 0 to 600 rpm when using rpm , or from 0 to 3600 degrees per second when using dps . If no velocity is provided, the robot turns at the current turn velocity. units velocityUnits The velocity unit: velocityUnits::pct (percent), rpm (rotations per minute), or dps (degrees per second). Return Values This function does not return a value. Notes turn is non-waiting; the project will continue executing the next line of code immediately after the call. The drivetrain will continue turning until stop is called or another drivetrain movement function (such as turnFor or drive ) is executed. Functions such as isDone and isMoving are not applicable to turn , since it does not use target-based movement (doesn't have an angle parameter). Examples // Turn right, then left, then stop
myDrivetrain.turn(right);
wait(2, seconds);
myDrivetrain.turn(left);
wait(2, seconds);
myDrivetrain.stop(); turnFor turnFor turns the robot left or right for a specific number of degrees. The turn is relative to the current position of the robot. The project will wait until the robot is done turning before the next line of code runs by default. For RPM or DPS, the limit is changed by the gear ratio of the drivetrain. Available Functions 1 - Turns for the specified angle using the currently configured turn velocity . bool turnFor(
    double        angle,
    rotationUnits units,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); 2 - Turns in the specified direction for an angle using the currently configured turn velocity . bool turnFor(
    turnType      dir,
    double        angle,
    rotationUnits units,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); 3 - Turns for the specified angle at the specified velocity. bool turnFor(
    double        angle,
    rotationUnits units,
    double        velocity,
    velocityUnits units_v,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); 4 - Turns in the specified direction for an angle at the specified velocity. bool turnFor(
    turnType      dir,
    double        angle,
    rotationUnits units,
    double        velocity,
    velocityUnits units_v,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); Parameters Parameter Type Description dir turnType The direction the robot turns: left or right . angle double The angle the robot turns. units rotationUnits The turn unit: deg (degrees), rev (revolutions), or raw (raw units). One revolution is equal to 360 degrees. velocity double The velocity to turn with from 0% to 100% when using velocityUnits::pct , from 0 to 600 rpm when using rpm , or from 0 to 3600 degrees per second when using dps . If no velocity is provided, the robot turns at the current turn velocity. units_v velocityUnits The velocity unit: velocityUnits::pct (percent), rpm (rotations per minute), or dps (degrees per second). waitForCompletion bool true (default) makes the project wait until the robot is done turning before the next line of code runs. false makes the next line of code run right away. Return Values Returns whether the robot reached the target angle, as a Boolean value. true - The robot reached the target angle. false - The robot did not finish the turn, or the function returned before the turn completed because waitForCompletion was set to false . Notes Executing another drivetrain movement function (such as turn or drive ) while turnFor is in progress will interrupt the current movement. Because turnFor is target-based (uses an angle parameter), functions such as isDone and isMoving work with turnFor . Examples // Turn right then left
myDrivetrain.turnFor(right, 90, degrees);
wait(1, seconds);
myDrivetrain.turnFor(left, 90, degrees); stop stop stops the robot's movement. If a stopping mode is provided, it controls how the robot stops for this function call. Available Functions 1 - Stops the drivetrain using the currently configured stopping mode . void stop(); 2 - Stops the drivetrain using the specified brake mode. void stop(
    brakeType mode ); Parameters Parameter Type Description mode brakeType How the robot will stop: brake - Stops immediately. coast - Slows to a stop. hold - Stops immediately and holds the wheels' position. Return Values This function does not return a value. Examples // Drive forward, then coast to a stop
myDrivetrain.setDriveVelocity(100, percent);
myDrivetrain.drive(forward);
wait(2, seconds);
myDrivetrain.stop(coast); Mutators setDriveVelocity setDriveVelocity tells the robot how fast to drive. A higher percentage makes the robot drive faster and a lower percentage makes the robot drive slower. For RPM, the limit is changed by the gear ratio of the drivetrain. Every project begins with the robot driving at 50% velocity by default. Note: A higher velocity makes the robot drive faster, but it may be less precise. A lower velocity makes the robot drive slower, but it can be more precise. Available Functions void  setDriveVelocity(
  double velocity,
  velocityUnits units ); Parameters Parameter Type Description velocity double The velocity to drive with from 0% to 100% when using velocityUnits::pct , from 0 to 600 rpm when using rpm , or from 0 to 3600 degrees per second when using dps . units velocityUnits The velocity unit: velocityUnits::pct (percent), rpm (rotations per minute), or dps (degrees per second). Return Values This function does not return a value. Notes The drive velocity applies to all subsequent drivetrain movement functions (such as drive and driveFor ) unless a specific velocity is provided in the function call. Examples // Drive forward, then coast to a stop
myDrivetrain.setDriveVelocity(100, percent);
myDrivetrain.drive(forward);
wait(2, seconds);
myDrivetrain.stop(coast); setTurnVelocity setTurnVelocity tells the robot how fast to turn. A higher percentage makes the robot turn faster and a lower percentage makes the robot turn slower. Every project begins with the robot turning at 50% velocity by default. Note: A higher velocity makes the robot turn faster, but it may be less precise. A lower velocity makes the robot turn slower, but it can be more precise. Available Functions void  setTurnVelocity(
  double velocity,
  velocityUnits units ); Parameters Parameter Type Description velocity double The velocity to turn with from 0% to 100% when using velocityUnits::pct , from 0 to 600 rpm when using rpm , or from 0 to 3600 degrees per second when using dps . units velocityUnits The velocity unit: percent or pct (percent), rpm (rotations per minute), or dps (degrees per second). Return Values This function does not return a value. Notes The turn velocity applies to all subsequent drivetrain turning functions (such as turn and turnFor ) unless a specific velocity is provided in the function call. Examples // Try default, slow, then fast
myDrivetrain.turnFor(right, 360, degrees);
wait(1, seconds);
myDrivetrain.setTurnVelocity(20, percent);
myDrivetrain.turnFor(right, 360, degrees);
wait(1, seconds);
myDrivetrain.setTurnVelocity(100, percent);
myDrivetrain.turnFor(right, 360, degrees); setStopping setStopping sets how the robot will stop moving: by braking, coasting, or holding. Available Functions void setStopping(
  brakeType mode ); Parameters Parameter Type Description mode brakeType How the robot will stop: brake - Stops immediately. coast - Slows to a stop. hold - Stops immediately and holds the wheels' position. Return Values This function does not return a value. Notes The stopping mode applies to all subsequent stop calls unless a specific stopping mode is provided in the function call. setTimeout setTimeout sets how many seconds the robot will try to finish a movement. If the robot cannot finish in that time, it will stop trying and move on to the next line of code. This keeps the robot from getting stuck on a movement. Available Functions void  setTimeout(
  int32_t time,
  timeUnits units ); Parameters Parameter Type Description time int32_t The amount of time the robot can try to finish a movement. This should be a positive whole number. units timeUnits The unit of time: sec (seconds) or msec (milliseconds). Return Values This function does not return a value. Notes The timeout only applies to target-based drivetrain movement functions (such as driveFor and turnFor ). Examples // Start turning if driving takes too long
myDrivetrain.setTimeout(1, seconds);
myDrivetrain.driveFor(forward, 25, inches);
myDrivetrain.turnFor(right, 90, degrees); Getters isDone isDone returns whether the robot is finished moving, as a Boolean value. This can be used to control the timing of other behaviors based on the robot's movement. Available Functions bool isDone( void ); Parameters This function does not accept any parameters. Return Values true - The robot is finished moving. false - The robot is still moving. Notes isDone is compatible with target-based drivetrain movements (functions that move to a target, such as driveFor and turnFor ). isDone is not compatible with functions such as drive and turn , since they do not use target-based movement. isMoving isMoving returns whether the robot is moving, as a Boolean value. This can be used to control the timing of other behaviors based on the robot's movement. Available Functions virtual bool isMoving( void ); Parameters This function does not accept any parameters. Return Values true - The robot is moving. false - The robot is not moving. Notes isMoving is compatible with target-based drivetrain movements (functions that move to a target, such as driveFor and turnFor ). isMoving is not compatible with functions such as drive and turn , since they do not use target-based movement. velocity velocity returns how fast the robot is driving. A positive value means the robot is driving forward. A negative value means the robot is driving in reverse. Available Functions double velocity(
  velocityUnits units ); Parameters Parameter Type Description units velocityUnits The velocity unit: percent or pct (percent), rpm (rotations per minute), or dps (degrees per second). Return Values Returns the drivetrain velocity as a double in the selected unit. Examples // Show velocity before and during motion
Brain.Screen.print("Resting: %f", myDrivetrain.velocity(percent));
myDrivetrain.drive(forward, 100, velocityUnits::pct);
wait(1, seconds);
Brain.Screen.newLine();
Brain.Screen.print("Moving: %f", myDrivetrain.velocity(percent));
myDrivetrain.stop(); current current returns how much electrical current the drivetrain is using. Current is the amount of electricity flowing through the drivetrain. It can be returned in amps (amperes) or as a percentage, depending on the unit. A higher current value means the drivetrain is using more electrical current. This can happen when the robot is pushing against an object or trying to move when it is stuck. This can be used to check if the drivetrain is struggling during a movement. If current stays high, the drivetrain may get warmer or use power less efficiently. Available Functions 1 - Returns the drivetrain's electrical current in amperes. double current(
    currentUnits units = currentUnits::amp ); 2 - Returns the drivetrain's electrical current as a percentage of maximum. double current(
    percentUnits units ); Parameters Parameter Type Description units currentUnits The unit to return current in: amp (amps, default). units percentUnits The unit to return current in: percent or pct . Return Values Returns the drivetrain current as a double in the selected unit. power power returns how much power the drivetrain is using, measured in watts. Power shows how quickly the drivetrain is using energy. A higher power value means the drivetrain is using energy faster. This can happen when the robot is pushing against an object or trying to move when it is stuck. This can be used to compare movements or check if the drivetrain is struggling. If power stays high, the drivetrain may get warmer or use energy less efficiently. Available Functions double power(
  powerUnits units = powerUnits::watt ); Parameters Parameter Type Description units powerUnits The power unit: watt (watts, default). Return Values Returns drivetrain power as a double in watts. torque Torque shows how hard the drivetrain can push or pull while the wheels spin. torque returns how much torque the drivetrain is using, measured in Newton-meters (Nm) or inch-pounds (InLb). A higher torque value means the drivetrain is pushing or pulling harder. This can happen when the robot is pushing against an object or trying to move when it is stuck. This can be used to check if the drivetrain is struggling or to compare how much push different movements need. Available Functions double torque(
  torqueUnits units = torqueUnits::nm ); Parameters Parameter Type Description units torqueUnits The unit to return torque in: Nm (newton meters, default) or InLb (inch pounds). Return Values Returns drivetrain torque as a double in the selected unit. efficiency efficiency returns how efficiently the drivetrain is using power, as a percentage from 0% to 100%. Efficiency shows how much of the drivetrain's power is being used for movement. A higher efficiency value means more of the drivetrain's power is being used to move. A lower efficiency value can happen when the drivetrain is working hard but not moving much, like when the robot is stuck or pushing against an object. This can be used to compare movements or check if the drivetrain is wasting power instead of using it for movement. Available Functions double efficiency(
  percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct ); Parameters Parameter Type Description units percentUnits The unit to return efficiency in: percent or pct (default). Return Values Returns drivetrain efficiency as a double in the selected unit. temperature temperature returns the average temperature of the drivetrain as a percentage from 0% to 100%. Temperature shows how warm the drivetrain motors are. A higher temperature means the motors are getting warmer while they work. The motors should stay below 55Â°C to keep working at full performance. If the motors get too hot, they will lower their maximum current to protect themselves. At 70Â°C, the motors will stop running until they cool down. This can be used to check if the drivetrain is getting too hot during repeated movements, long runs, or when it is pushing against an object. Available Functions double temperature(
  percentUnits units ); Parameters Parameter Type Description units percentUnits The unit to return temperature in: percent or pct . Return Values Returns the average drivetrain temperature as a double in the selected unit. Notes A returned value of 50% indicates that the average motor temperature is approximately 45Â°C ( 113Â°F ). The typical operating temperature range for the drivetrain is approximately 20Â°C ( 68Â°F ) to 70Â°C ( 158Â°F ). voltage voltage returns the electrical voltage supplied to the drivetrain. Voltage is the electrical pressure supplied to the drivetrain motors. This can be used with current and power values to understand how the drivetrain is using electrical energy. Available Functions double  voltage(
  voltageUnits units = voltageUnits::volt ); Parameters Parameter Type Description units voltageUnits The unit to return voltage in: volt (volts, default) or voltageUnits::mV (millivolts). Return Values Returns drivetrain voltage as a double in the selected unit.

传动系统 概述 drivetrain 类用于控制机器人的行驶与转向。传动系统由电机和车轮组成，各部件协同工作以驱动机器人运动。 drivetrain 不使用 惯性传感器 、 陀螺仪 或 GPS 传感器 进行基于航向角或基于旋转的转弯。它可以前进或后退以及左转或右转，但不能转向特定的航向角或旋转。对于基于航向角和基于旋转的转弯，请使用 smartdrive 类。 派生类 drivetrain 类用作以下派生类的基类： smartdrive - 该类添加了惯性传感器、GPS 传感器或陀螺仪支持，以实现基于航向角和基于旋转的转弯。 构造函数 1 - 使用现有的 motor_group 对象为左侧 ( &l ) 和右侧 ( &r ) 创建传动系统。 drivetrain(
    motor_group      &l,
    motor_group      &r,
    double           wheelTravel = 320,
    double           trackWidth = 320,
    double           wheelBase = 130,
    distanceUnits    unit = mm,
    double           externalGearRatio = 1.0 ); 2 - 使用现有的 motor 对象为左侧 ( &l ) 和右侧 ( &r ) 创建传动系统。 drivetrain(
    motor            &l,
    motor            &r,
    double           wheelTravel = 320,
    double           trackWidth = 320,
    double           wheelBase = 130,
    distanceUnits    unit = mm,
    double           externalGearRatio = 1.0 ); 析构函数 销毁 drivetrain 对象并释放关联资源。 virtual ~drivetrain(); 参数 参数 类型 说明 &l / &r motor_group / motor 左右电机或电机组。两个参数必须使用相同的类型：两个 motor_group 对象或两个 motor 对象。 wheelTravel double 传动系统车轮的周长，默认值为 320 。 trackWidth double 左右车轮之间的距离（轮距），默认值为 320 。 wheelBase double 前后车轮之间的距离（轴距），默认值为 130 。 unit distanceUnits wheelTravel 、 trackWidth 和 wheelBase 的单位： mm （毫米，默认）或 inches 。 externalGearRatio double 如果使用齿轮，则齿轮传动比用于调节驱动距离。默认为 1.0 。 示例 // Create the left and right motor objects
motor leftMotor = motor(PORT1, false);
motor rightMotor = motor(PORT9, true);

// Create the drivetrain object
drivetrain myDrivetrain = drivetrain(
    leftMotor,  // left motor object
    rightMotor, // right motor object
    259.34,     // wheelTravel
    320,        // trackWidth
    40,         // wheelBase
    mm,         // unit
    1.0 );      // externalGearRatio 成员函数 drivetrain 类包含以下成员函数： 动作 - 移动并转动机器人。 drive - 使机器人永远向前或向后移动。 driveFor - 将机器人向前或向后移动特定距离。 turn - 永远向左或向右转动机器人。 turnFor - 将机器人向左或向右转动特定的度数。 stop - 停止机器人的运动。 设置 - 调整传动系统设置。 setDriveVelocity - 告诉机器人行驶速度。 setTurnVelocity - 告诉机器人转动的速度。 setStopping - 说明机器人如何停止移动：通过制动、自由滑行或保持位置。 setTimeout - 设置机器人将尝试完成运动的秒数。 值 - 检查运动状态。 isDone - 返回机器人是否完成移动，作为布尔值。 isMoving - 返回机器人是否正在移动，作为布尔值。 velocity - 返回机器人的行驶速度。 current - 返回传动系统正在使用的电流量。 power - 返回传动系统使用能量的速度。 torque - 返回传动系统正在使用多少 TX。 efficiency - 返回传动系统使用电源的效率。 temperature - 返回传动系统的温度。 voltage - 返回提供给传动系统的电压。 在调用任何 drivetrain 成员函数之前，必须创建一个 drivetrain 对象，如下所示： /* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
Drivetrain configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create the left and right motor objects
motor leftMotor = motor(PORT1, false);
motor rightMotor = motor(PORT9, true);

// Create the drivetrain object
drivetrain myDrivetrain = drivetrain(
    leftMotor,  // left motor object
    rightMotor, // right motor object
    259.34,     // wheelTravel
    320,        // trackWidth
    40,         // wheelBase
    mm,         // unit
    1.0 );      // externalGearRatio 动作控制 drive drive 使机器人持续前进或后退，直到收到转向、停止等其他动作指令。使用 RPM 或 DPS 单位时，速度上限会随传动系统的齿轮传动比而变化。 函数重载 1 - 使用当前 配置的驱动速度 进行驱动。 void drive(
    directionType dir ); 2 - 以指定速度驱动。 void drive(
    directionType dir,
    double        velocity,
    velocityUnits units ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 dir directionType 机器人移动的方向： forward 或 reverse 。 velocity double 使用 velocityUnits::pct 时，驱动速度为 0% 到 100%；使用 rpm 时，驱动速度为 0 到 600 rpm；使用 dps 时，驱动速度为 0 到 3600 度/秒。如果未提供速度，机器人将以当前驱动速度驱动。 units velocityUnits 速度单位： velocityUnits::pct （百分比）、 rpm （每分钟转数）或 dps （每秒度数）。 返回值 此函数无返回值。 说明与注意事项 drive 为非阻塞；项目将在调用后立即继续执行下一行代码。 传动系统将继续运动，直至调用 stop 或执行另一个传动系统运动函数（如 driveFor 或 turn ）。 功能如 isDone 和 isMoving 不适用于 drive ，因为它不使用目标运动（没有 distance 参数）。 示例 // Drive forward and back
myDrivetrain.drive(forward);
wait(2, seconds);
myDrivetrain.drive(reverse, 25, rpm);
wait(2, seconds);
myDrivetrain.stop(); driveFor driveFor 使机器人前进或后退指定距离。默认情况下，程序会等待该运动完成后，再执行下一行代码。使用 RPM 或 DPS 单位时，速度上限会随传动系统的齿轮传动比而变化。 函数重载 1 - 使用当前 配置的驱动速度 在指定方向驱动一段距离。 bool driveFor(
    directionType dir,
    double        distance,
    distanceUnits units,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); 2 - 使用当前 配置的驱动速度 沿取决于距离的方向驱动。 bool driveFor(
    double        distance,
    distanceUnits units,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); 3 - 以指定速度沿取决于距离的方向行驶。 bool driveFor(
    double        distance,
    distanceUnits units,
    double        velocity,
    velocityUnits units_v,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); 4 - 以指定速度沿指定方向行驶一段距离。 bool driveFor(
    directionType dir,
    double        distance,
    distanceUnits units,
    double        velocity,
    velocityUnits units_v,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 dir directionType 机器人移动的方向： forward 或 reverse 。 distance double 机器人行驶的距离。 units distanceUnits 距离单位： mm （毫米）、 inches 或 cm （厘米）。 velocity double 使用 velocityUnits::pct 时，驱动速度为 0% 到 100%；使用 rpm 时，驱动速度为 0 到 600 rpm；使用 dps 时，驱动速度为 0 到 3600 度/秒。如果未提供速度，机器人将以当前驱动速度驱动。 units_v velocityUnits 速度单位： velocityUnits::pct （百分比）、 rpm （每分钟转数）或 dps （每秒度数）。 waitForCompletion bool true （默认）使项目等到机器人完成移动后再运行下一行代码。 false 使下一行代码立即运行。 返回值 以布尔值的形式返回机器人是否到达目标距离。 true - 机器人到达目标距离。 false - 机器人未完成运动，或者由于 waitForCompletion 设置为 false ，所以函数在运动完成之前返回。 备注 在 driveFor 正在进行时执行另一个传动系统运动功能（如 drive 或 turnFor ）将中断当前运动。 由于 driveFor 是基于目标的（使用 distance 参数），因此 isDone 和 isMoving 等函数可与 driveFor 配合使用。 示例 // Drive 200 mm, then back 200 mm
myDrivetrain.driveFor(forward, 200, mm);
myDrivetrain.driveFor(reverse, 200, mm); turn turn 使机器人持续向左或向右转动，直到收到行驶、停止等其他动作指令。使用 RPM 或 DPS 单位时，速度上限会随传动系统的齿轮传动比而变化。 函数重载 1 - 使用当前 配置的转弯速度 进行转弯。 void turn(
    turnType dir ); 2 - 以指定速度转动。 void turn(
    turnType     dir,
    double       velocity,
    velocityUnits units ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 dir turnType 机器人转向的方向： left 或 right 。 velocity double 使用 velocityUnits::pct 时，转动速度从 0% 到 100%；使用 rpm 时，转动速度从 0 到 600 rpm；使用 dps 时，转动速度从 0 到 3600 度/秒。如果未提供速度，机器人将以当前转动速度转动。 units velocityUnits 速度单位： velocityUnits::pct （百分比）、 rpm （每分钟转数）或 dps （每秒度数）。 返回值 此函数无返回值。 说明与注意事项 turn 为非阻塞；项目将在调用后立即继续执行下一行代码。 传动系统将继续转动，直至调用 stop 或执行另一个传动系统运动功能（如 turnFor 或 drive ）。 功能如 isDone 和 isMoving 不适用于 turn ，因为它不使用目标运动（没有 angle 参数）。 示例 // Turn right, then left, then stop
myDrivetrain.turn(right);
wait(2, seconds);
myDrivetrain.turn(left);
wait(2, seconds);
myDrivetrain.stop(); turnFor turnFor 使机器人相对于当前位置向左或向右转过指定角度。默认情况下，程序会等待转向完成后，再执行下一行代码。使用 RPM 或 DPS 单位时，速度上限会随传动系统的齿轮传动比而变化。 函数重载 1 - 使用当前 配置的转弯速度 转弯指定角度。 bool turnFor(
    double        angle,
    rotationUnits units,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); 2 - 使用当前 配置的转弯速度 在指定方向上转弯一定角度。 bool turnFor(
    turnType      dir,
    double        angle,
    rotationUnits units,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); 3 - 以指定速度转动指定角度。 bool turnFor(
    double        angle,
    rotationUnits units,
    double        velocity,
    velocityUnits units_v,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); 4 - 以指定速度沿指定方向转动一定角度。 bool turnFor(
    turnType      dir,
    double        angle,
    rotationUnits units,
    double        velocity,
    velocityUnits units_v,
    bool          waitForCompletion = true ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 dir turnType 机器人转向的方向： left 或 right 。 angle double 机器人转动的角度。 units rotationUnits 转动单位： deg （度）、 rev （转）或 raw （原始单位）。一圈等于 360 度。 velocity double 使用 velocityUnits::pct 时，转动速度从 0% 到 100%；使用 rpm 时，转动速度从 0 到 600 rpm；使用 dps 时，转动速度从 0 到 3600 度/秒。如果未提供速度，机器人将以当前转动速度转动。 units_v velocityUnits 速度单位： velocityUnits::pct （百分比）、 rpm （每分钟转数）或 dps （每秒度数）。 waitForCompletion bool true （默认）使项目等到机器人完成转动后才运行下一行代码。 false 使下一行代码立即运行。 返回值 以 布尔 值的形式返回机器人是否到达目标角度。 true - 机器人到达目标角度。 false - 机器人未完成转弯，或者由于 waitForCompletion 设置为 false ，因此函数在转弯完成之前返回。 备注 在 turnFor 正在进行时执行另一个传动系统运动功能（如 turn 或 drive ）将中断当前运动。 由于 turnFor 是基于目标的（使用 angle 参数），因此 isDone 和 isMoving 等函数可与 turnFor 配合使用。 示例 // Turn right then left
myDrivetrain.turnFor(right, 90, degrees);
wait(1, seconds);
myDrivetrain.turnFor(left, 90, degrees); stop stop 停止机器人的运动。如果在本次调用中指定停止模式，则按指定模式停止。 函数重载 1 - 使用当前配置的 停止模式 停止传动系统。 void stop(); 2 - 使用指定的制动模式停止传动系统。 void stop(
    brakeType mode ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 mode brakeType 机器人如何停止： brake - 立即停止。 coast - 减速直至停止。 hold - 立即停止并保持车轮位置。 返回值 此函数无返回值。 示例 // Drive forward, then coast to a stop
myDrivetrain.setDriveVelocity(100, percent);
myDrivetrain.drive(forward);
wait(2, seconds);
myDrivetrain.stop(coast); 设置方法 setDriveVelocity setDriveVelocity 告诉机器人行驶的速度。百分比越高，机器人行驶得越快，百分比越低，机器人行驶得越慢。对于 RPM，限制由传动系统的齿轮传动比改变。 每个项目开始时机器人默认以 50% 的速度行驶。 注： 较高的速度使机器人行驶得更快，但精度可能较低。较低的速度会使机器人行驶得更慢，但可以更精确。 函数重载 void  setDriveVelocity(
  double velocity,
  velocityUnits units ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 velocity double 使用 velocityUnits::pct 时，驱动速度为 0% 到 100%；使用 rpm 时，驱动速度为 0 到 600 rpm；使用 dps 时，驱动速度为 0 到 3600 度/秒。 units velocityUnits 速度单位： velocityUnits::pct （百分比）、 rpm （每分钟转数）或 dps （每秒度数）。 返回值 此函数无返回值。 说明与注意事项 驱动器速度适用于所有后续传动系统运动功能（例如 drive 和 driveFor ），除非在函数调用中提供了特定速度。 示例 // Drive forward, then coast to a stop
myDrivetrain.setDriveVelocity(100, percent);
myDrivetrain.drive(forward);
wait(2, seconds);
myDrivetrain.stop(coast); setTurnVelocity setTurnVelocity 告诉机器人转动的速度。百分比越高，机器人转动得越快，百分比越低，机器人转动得越慢。 每个项目开始时机器人默认以 50% 的速度转动。 注： 较高的速度使机器人转动得更快，但精度可能较低。较低的速度会使机器人转动得更慢，但可以更精确。 函数重载 void  setTurnVelocity(
  double velocity,
  velocityUnits units ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 velocity double 使用 velocityUnits::pct 时，转动速度从 0% 到 100%；使用 rpm 时，转动速度从 0 到 600 rpm；使用 dps 时，转动速度从 0 到 3600 度/秒。 units velocityUnits 速度单位： percent 或 pct （百分比）、 rpm （每分钟转数）或 dps （每秒度数）。 返回值 此函数无返回值。 说明与注意事项 转动速度适用于所有后续传动系统转动功能（例如 turn 和 turnFor ），除非在函数调用中提供了特定速度。 示例 // Try default, slow, then fast
myDrivetrain.turnFor(right, 360, degrees);
wait(1, seconds);
myDrivetrain.setTurnVelocity(20, percent);
myDrivetrain.turnFor(right, 360, degrees);
wait(1, seconds);
myDrivetrain.setTurnVelocity(100, percent);
myDrivetrain.turnFor(right, 360, degrees); setStopping setStopping 设置机器人如何停止移动：通过制动、自由滑行或保持位置。 函数重载 void setStopping(
  brakeType mode ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 mode brakeType 机器人如何停止： brake - 立即停止。 coast - 减速直至停止。 hold - 立即停止并保持车轮位置。 返回值 此函数无返回值。 说明与注意事项 除非函数调用中提供了特定的停止模式，否则停止模式适用于所有后续的 stop 调用。 setTimeout setTimeout 设置完成一次运动所允许的最长尝试时间，单位为秒。如果在该时间内未能完成运动，机器人会停止尝试，程序继续执行下一行代码，以免一直等待无法完成的动作。 函数重载 void  setTimeout(
  int32_t time,
  timeUnits units ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 time int32_t 机器人可以尝试完成动作的时间量。这应该是一个正整数。 units timeUnits 时间单位： sec （秒）或 msec （毫秒）。 返回值 此函数无返回值。 说明与注意事项 该超时仅适用于基于目标的传动系统运动功能（例如 driveFor 和 turnFor ）。 示例 // Start turning if driving takes too long
myDrivetrain.setTimeout(1, seconds);
myDrivetrain.driveFor(forward, 25, inches);
myDrivetrain.turnFor(right, 90, degrees); 读取方法 isDone isDone 以布尔值的形式返回机器人是否完成移动。这可用于根据机器人的运动来控制其他行为的时间。 函数重载 bool isDone( void ); 参数 该函数不接受任何参数。 返回值 true - 机器人完成移动。 false - 机器人仍在移动。 备注 isDone 与基于目标的传动系统运动兼容（移动到目标的功能，例如 driveFor 和 turnFor ）。 isDone 与 drive 和 turn 等功能不兼容，因为它们不使用目标运动。 isMoving isMoving 以布尔值的形式返回机器人是否正在移动。这可用于根据机器人的运动来控制其他行为的时间。 函数重载 virtual bool isMoving( void ); 参数 该函数不接受任何参数。 返回值 true - 机器人正在移动。 false - 机器人没有移动。 备注 isMoving 与基于目标的传动系统运动兼容（移动到目标的功能，例如 driveFor 和 turnFor ）。 isMoving 与 drive 和 turn 等功能不兼容，因为它们不使用目标运动。 velocity velocity 返回机器人的行驶速度。 正值表示机器人正在向前行驶。负值表示机器人正在倒车。 函数重载 double velocity(
  velocityUnits units ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units velocityUnits 速度单位： percent 或 pct （百分比）、 rpm （每分钟转数）或 dps （每秒度数）。 返回值 以所选单位的 double 形式返回传动系统速度。 示例 // Show velocity before and during motion
Brain.Screen.print("Resting: %f", myDrivetrain.velocity(percent));
myDrivetrain.drive(forward, 100, velocityUnits::pct);
wait(1, seconds);
Brain.Screen.newLine();
Brain.Screen.print("Moving: %f", myDrivetrain.velocity(percent));
myDrivetrain.stop(); current current 返回传动系统的电流读数，用于反映流经传动系统的电流大小。根据所选单位，可用安培或百分比表示。 电流值越高意味着传动系统使用更多的电流。当机器人推动物体或在物体被卡住时试图移动时，可能会发生这种情况。 这可用于检查传动系统在运动过程中是否有困难。如果电流保持较高水平，传动系统可能会变热或电力使用效率降低。 函数重载 1 - 返回传动系统的电流（以安培为单位）。 double current(
    currentUnits units = currentUnits::amp ); 2 - 以最大值的百分比形式返回传动系统的电流。 double current(
    percentUnits units ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units currentUnits 返回电流的单位： amp （安培，默认）。 units percentUnits 返回电流的单位： percent 或 pct 。 返回值 以所选单位的 double 形式返回传动系统电流。 power power 返回传动系统的功率，单位为瓦。功率表示消耗能量的速率。 功率值越高意味着传动系统使用能量的速度越快。当机器人推动物体或在物体被卡住时试图移动时，就会发生这种情况。 这可用于比较运动或检查传动系统是否有困难。如果功率保持在高水平，传动系统可能会变热或能源使用效率降低。 函数重载 double power(
  powerUnits units = powerUnits::watt ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units powerUnits 功率单位： watt （瓦，默认）。 返回值 返回 double 形式的传动系统功率（以瓦为单位）。 torque 扭矩反映车轮转动时，传动系统产生推力或拉力的能力。 torque 返回传动系统正在使用的扭矩数量，以牛·米 (Nm) 或磅力·英寸 (InLb) 为单位进行测量。 较高的 TX 值意味着传动系统的推拉力更强。当机器人推动物体或在物体被卡住时试图移动时，就会发生这种情况。 这可用于检查传动系统是否困难或比较不同运动需要多少推力。 函数重载 double torque(
  torqueUnits units = torqueUnits::nm ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units torqueUnits 返回 BTC 的单位为： Nm （牛·米，默认）或 InLb （磅力·英寸）。 返回值 以所选单位中的 double 形式返回传输系统蓝牙。 efficiency efficiency 返回传动系统使用功率的效率，以 0% 到 100% 的百分比表示。 效率表明有多少传动系统的动力用于运动。效率值越高，意味着更多的传动系统动力被用于移动。当传动系统正在努力工作但移动量不大时，例如当机器人被卡住或推向物体时，可能会出现较低的效率值。 这可用于比较运动或检查传动系统是否浪费功率而不是使用它进行运动。 函数重载 double efficiency(
  percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units percentUnits 返回效率的单位： percent 或 pct （默认）。 返回值 以所选单位的 double 形式返回传动系统效率。 temperature temperature 以 0% 到 100% 的百分比形式返回传动系统的平均温度。 温度显示了传动系统电机的温度。较高的温度意味着电机在工作时会变热。电机应保持在 55°C 以下才能保持最佳性能工作。 如果电机变得太热，它们会降低最大电流以保护自己。在 70°C 时，电机将停止运行直至冷却。 这可用于检查传动系统在重复运动、长时间运行或推动物体时是否变得太热。 函数重载 double temperature(
  percentUnits units ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units percentUnits 返回温度的单位为： percent 或 pct 。 返回值 以所选单位的 double 形式返回平均传动系统温度。 说明与注意事项 返回值 50% 表示电机平均温度约为 45Â°C ( 113Â°F )。 传动系统的典型工作温度范围约为 20Â°C ( 68Â°F ) 至 70Â°C ( 158Â°F )。 voltage voltage 返回提供给传动系统的电压。 电压是提供给传动系统电机的电压。这可以与电流和功率值结合使用，以了解传动系统如何使用电能。 函数重载 double  voltage(
  voltageUnits units = voltageUnits::volt ); 参数 参数 类型 说明 units voltageUnits 返回电压的单位： volt （伏特，默认）或 voltageUnits::mV （毫伏）。 返回值 以所选单位的 double 形式返回传动系统电压。

documents.title: smartdrive
documents.intro: The smartdrive class controls how a robot drives and turns using motors, wheels, and a sensor. A smartdrive can use an Inertial Sensor , Gyro Sensor , or GPS Sensor to track heading and rotation.
documents.zhIntro: smartdrive 类控制机器人如何使用电机、轮子和传感器驱动和转动。 smartdrive 可以使用 惯性传感器 、 陀螺仪 或 GPS 传感器 来跟踪航向角和旋转。

documents.title: Comments
documents.intro: Comments in C++ are used to add explanations or notes within the code. They do not affect how the code runs and are useful for clarifying logic, documenting functionality, or temporarily disabling parts of the code.
documents.zhIntro: C++ 中的注释用于在代码中添加解释或注释。它们不会影响代码的运行方式，并且对于澄清逻辑、记录功能或暂时禁用部分代码很有用。

documents.title: Control
documents.intro: Control includes functions for timing, program flow, conditional logic, and project termination. These controls let you pause execution, create loops, define logic paths, and end a program.
documents.zhIntro: 控制包括定时、程序流程、条件逻辑和项目终止的功能。这些控件允许您暂停执行、创建循环、定义逻辑路径和结束程序。

documents.title: Custom Colors
documents.intro: The color class is used to define and modify colors for drawing shapes and displaying text on the V5 Brain Screen. Colors can be created using RGB values, hexadecimal color codes, HSV values, or predefined color constants.
documents.zhIntro: color 类用于定义和修改V5主控器屏幕上绘制形状和显示文本的颜色。可以使用 RGB 值、十六进制颜色码、HSV 值或预定义的颜色常量创建颜色。

documents.title: Custom String Formatting
documents.intro: String formatting in C++ for VEX V5 uses printf -style format specifiers to create strings that include variables, expressions, or values. This method uses format specifiers like %d , %f , %s , etc., to insert values into strings.
documents.zhIntro: VEX V5 的 C++ 字符串格式使用 printf 样式格式说明符来创建包含变量、表达式或值的字符串。此方法使用 %d 、 %f 、 %s 等格式说明符将值插入到字符串中。

documents.title: Custom Timer
documents.intro: The timer class is used to keep time and interact with a timer independent of the Brain's timer .
documents.zhIntro: timer 类用于计时并与独立于 主控器定时器 的定时器交互。

documents.title: Events
documents.intro: Events let you start a function asynchronously. When an event is broadcast, the event’s callback function is started in its own task (thread), so your main code can continue running at the same time.
documents.zhIntro: 事件允许您异步启动函数。当事件被广播时，事件的回调函数会在其自己的任务（线程）中启动，因此您的主代码可以同时继续运行。

documents.title: Functions
documents.intro: Functions are a fundamental component of C++ programming, packaging code snippets into reusable, efficient sections of code designed to perform a specific task. Functions can be called multiple times within a program, making code organization easier, and helping to avoid repeated code. Functions also make code easier to debug.
documents.zhIntro: 函数是 C++ 编程的基本组成部分，它将代码片段打包成可重用、高效的代码段，旨在执行特定任务。函数可以在程序中多次调用，使代码组织更容易，并有助于避免重复代码。函数还使代码更易于调试。

documents.title: Math
documents.intro: The C++ standard library provides basic math functionality through <cmath> , which is supported in VEXcode V5. These functions let you perform common mathematical operations such as trigonometry, rounding, exponentiation, and more.
documents.zhIntro: C++ 标准库通过 <cmath> 提供基本数学功能，VEXcode V5 中支持该功能。这些函数可让您执行常见的数学运算，例如三角、舍入、求幂等。

documents.title: Operators
documents.intro: Operators in C++ are symbols that let you perform operations on variables and values. They include arithmetic, logical, comparison, assignment, and bitwise operators. C++ also supports increment/decrement, conditional expressions, and compound assignment. These form the core of most logic and math in any C++ program, including robotics control with VEXcode V5.
documents.zhIntro: C++ 中的运算符是允许您对变量和值执行运算的符号。它们包括算术运算符、逻辑运算符、比较运算符、赋值运算符和位运算符。 C++ 还支持递增/递减、条件表达式和复合赋值。它们构成了任何 C++ 程序中大多数逻辑和数学的核心，包括使用 VEXcode V5 进行机器人控制。
documents.text: Operators Introduction Operators in C++ are symbols that let you perform operations on variables and values. They include arithmetic, logical, comparison, assignment, and bitwise operators. C++ also supports increment/decrement, conditional expressions, and compound assignment. These form the core of most logic and math in any C++ program, including robotics control with VEXcode V5.
